guarantees.claim: Reset (rst_ni low) asynchronously clears sw_key_data_reg[0] to zero.
When engine_stable is high, for each j in 0..MaxKeyLen/32-1, if key_share0[j].qe is true, sw_key_data_reg[0][32*j+:32] is updated with key_share0[j].q.
When not in reset and (engine_stable is low or key_share0[j].qe is low), sw_key_data_reg[0][32*j+:32] retains its previous value.

assumptions.claim: MaxKeyLen is a multiple of 32 and does not exceed the bit-width of sw_key_data_reg[0] or the depth of the key_share0 array.
assumptions.risk: Out-of-bounds indexing could corrupt adjacent storage or cause synthesis/simulation mismatch, potentially exposing or corrupting key material.

assumptions.claim: engine_stable remains high and stable for the entire duration of the key update transaction to ensure atomic write of all key words that have qe set.
assumptions.cond: when key update transaction occurs (engine_stable high and any qe active)
assumptions.risk: If engine_stable deasserts mid-update, partial key may be written, resulting in a corrupted key that compromises cryptographic security.

uncertain_points.claim: If MaxKeyLen is not a multiple of 32, the for-loop may miss updating the tail bits of sw_key_data_reg[0], leaving potential key bits uninitialized or stale.
uncertain_points.risk: Uninitialized or stale key bits can cause unpredictable cryptographic operations and may leak side-channel information.

uncertain_points.claim: engine_stable source and timing must be verified to be glitch-free and asserted only when the cryptographic engine is truly idle and not in the middle of a key-consuming operation.
uncertain_points.risk: A glitch on engine_stable could trigger unintended key updates, corrupting the key and potentially causing security failures.

uncertain_points.claim: sw_key_data_reg[0] is cleared only at reset; there is no explicit mechanism to zeroize the key after use, which may leave residual key material exposed.
uncertain_points.cond: after cryptographic operation completes and engine_stable deasserts
uncertain_points.risk: Residual key could be extracted via later read paths, faults, or debug access, violating secret-key confidentiality.

uncertain_points.claim: The key update is not guaranteed to be atomic: if engine_stable spans multiple clock cycles and qe bits are asserted at different times, sw_key_data_reg[0] can be partially updated with a mix of old and new key words.
uncertain_points.cond: engine_stable high over multiple clock cycles with different qe patterns
uncertain_points.risk: Non-atomic key loading could produce a key never intended by software, leading to incorrect MAC outputs and potential security bypass.
